=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
TASK_GAP
Requirement: CLAUDE.md §20.A requires a `changelog.d/<issue-or-pr>-<slug>.md` fragment when a PR changes observable behavior. The trigger conditions explicitly include "new or changed CLI flags, env vars, repo vars, workflow inputs/outputs" and "security fixes and data-loss fixes". This PR does both: it introduces a new env var `CLAUDE_FIXER_HANDOFF_AUTHOR_LOGIN` and it is the documented security fix for the forgeable Claude-fixer hand-off vulnerability (issue #4471, severity `medium`, confidence `9/10`). The closest precedent fragment is `changelog.d/4453-claude-fixer-verdict-verification.md`, which documents a sibling security hardening (the verdict-verification change) and uses a `<!-- changelog: security -->` or `<!-- changelog: fixed -->` marker.
Expected change site: `changelog.d/4471-claude-fixer-handoff-author.md` (or similar kebab-case slug) at the repo root.
Evidence of absence: No `changelog.d/4471-*.md` file exists in the working tree (verified by `glob` of `changelog.d/4471*` returning no files). The PR diff only updates `.ai/.workspace_source_manifest.txt` to list fragment entries for prior PRs (lines 167-169); no new fragment is created. The `scripts/assemble_changelog.py` assembler folds fragments into `CHANGELOG.md` at release time; without a fragment, the security fix will not be communicated to consumers on the next `@stable` sync.
SEVERITY: MAJOR
ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5

TASK_GAP
Requirement: The new env var `CLAUDE_FIXER_HANDOFF_AUTHOR_LOGIN` is added to the README.md env vars table at line 87. The companion `agents.md` body text describing the Claude-fixer mode (lines 72-96) explicitly mentions the two related env vars inline: `CLAUDE_FIXER_ENABLED` (line 72, "Claude-fixer mode (CLAUDE_FIXER_ENABLED, default on)") and `CLAUDE_FIXER_VERDICT_BOT_LOGIN` (line 81-82, "`CLAUDE_FIXER_VERDICT_BOT_LOGIN` defaults empty, disabling verdict convergence"). The new var governs the same Claude-fixer trust boundary, but `grep` of agents.md returns no reference to `CLAUDE_FIXER_HANDOFF_AUTHOR_LOGIN` — only the existing `CLAUDE_FIXER_HANDOFF` log prefix (line 1391) appears. Without an inline reference in agents.md, the consumer-facing security contract documented in the body text is incomplete: agents.md describes the trust boundary for Claude-fixer mode but does not name the env var the operator must configure to enable it.
Expected change site: `agents.md` lines 72-96 (Claude-fixer mode description paragraph), adding an inline reference to `CLAUDE_FIXER_HANDOFF_AUTHOR_LOGIN` consistent with how `CLAUDE_FIXER_VERDICT_BOT_LOGIN` is referenced.
Evidence of absence: `grep` of agents.md for `CLAUDE_FIXER_HANDOFF_AUTHOR_LOGIN` returns no matches; the README.md table at line 87 is the only documentation site for this env var.
SEVERITY: NIT
ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
